Research question: "What measurements or analyses would best reveal why a small fraction of genetically identical cancer cells survive targeted drug treatment?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Barcoded lineage tracing with pre-treatment sister-cell splitting
ideas.description: Tag cells with heritable expression barcodes, split the population into sister aliquots, and treat one while sequencing the other (scRNA-seq) before drug. Persister lineages can then be traced back to their pre-existing transcriptional states, which tests whether survival is predetermined or stochastic. Like the 'mesh' and 'sync' words in the material, the design relies on matching paired units across two conditions.

ideas.title: Live-cell time-lapse imaging with reporter fate tracking
ideas.description: Image cells with fluorescent reporters for cell cycle (FUCCI), apoptosis, and stress pathways (e.g., ERK, p53) for days before and after drug addition. Retrospectively link single-cell dynamics, such as cycle length, pulsatile signaling, or mitochondrial state, to survival or death. This adds the temporal dimension that fixed snapshots miss.

ideas.title: Single-cell multi-omic profiling of persisters (RNA + ATAC + protein)
ideas.description: Profile surviving cells and untreated controls at several timepoints with joint scRNA/scATAC and phospho-proteomics. This would identify chromatin accessibility and signaling states, such as an epigenetic drug-tolerant program or reactivated bypass pathways, that distinguish persisters. Comparing early and late timepoints separates selection of pre-existing states from drug-induced adaptation.

ideas.title: Functional perturbation screens within persisters (CRISPRi/a and epigenetic inhibitors)
ideas.description: Run pooled CRISPR screens, or treat with chromatin modifier inhibitors such as HDAC or KDM5 inhibitors, in combination with the targeted drug. Measure persister numbers to find causal regulators of survival rather than correlates. Hits from the profiling experiments can then be validated by checking whether knockdown shrinks the persister fraction.

ideas.title: Metabolic and stress-state measurements at single-cell resolution
ideas.description: Measure ROS, mitochondrial membrane potential, lipid peroxidation (GPX4 dependence), and drug efflux or intracellular drug concentration in individual cells with flow cytometry or FLIM. Sort high and low cells, expose them to drug, and test whether these states predict survival. This tests non-genetic physiological explanations such as ferroptosis resistance or lower drug accumulation.
